name: Run the platformer and editor on the Mac

comments.text: Dean ran the Nox platformer and the world editor on his Mac on 2026-11-05: menu, play, 60 fps, audio, window handling and the editor checklist (outliner drag, view cube, selection cycling, play in editor) all work. Nyx needs Homebrew llvm 20 or later; llvm@19's libc++ has no floating-point from_chars.
